description: Consent to display one internally illuminated totem sign and small fascia mounted signs and one non-illuminated fascia mounted sign, internally illuminated poster display unit and one non-illuminated large fascia mounted sign.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 6 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity

Condition : 7 - The luminance of the signs shall not exceed 300 cd/m2 at any time and 395 cd/m2 for the poster display unit, or exceed the levels set out in the Institution of Lighting Professionals report PLG05 THE BRIGHTNESS OF ILLUMINATED ADVERTISEMENTS (2015).
Condition : 8 - The proposed signage must not have any intermittent light source, animation, moving feature or exposed cold cathode tubing.
Condition : 9 - The advertisement shall not be illuminated outside the stores opening hours. Outside these hours the illumination shall be switched off.
Condition : 10 - Prior to the installation of the proposed totem sign as shown on plan 5260-1004 Rev P04, the existing totem sign on Staines Road shall be dismantled and fully removed.
